conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="${CLUSTER_NAME}" AND jsonPayload.msg="Actor crashed" AND jsonPayload."ate.atespace"="${ATESPACE}"

documentation.content: An actor moved to CRASHED: its live execution is lost. This is a log-based alert on ateapi's `Actor crashed` record, so the incident names the actor (`actor` label) and the operation it was in. It fires on every crash, including the first one for a template: a metric alert on `increase({"ate.actor.crashes"}[…])` misses that one, because the counter series is born at 1 and `increase()` needs two samples. Read why with `kubectl ate get actor <name> -a ${ATESPACE} -o yaml` (`status.crash.message`), then `kubectl ate revert actor <name> -a ${ATESPACE}` to send it back to SUSPENDED from its last snapshot.
